geometry_edits: Rebuilt the one-piece massing shell from Indiana 2018 LiDAR footprint objectid 409920 (14-vertex roof envelope), independently registered against Indiana current orthophoto and compared with Purdue official FID 784.
Kept stable ID, manifest path, scene, collection, object name, identity transform and campus X-east/Y-north/Z-up coordinate contract.

Projected in native EPSG:2968, converting US survey feet with the exact US survey-foot factor. LiDAR roof polygon area is approximately 598.27 m² and perimeter 149.23 m; Purdue FID 784 polygon is approximately 476.20 m² and 122.65 m. IoU is 0.7573.

Reconciled the published Shape__Area/Shape__Length conflict: across both datasets the reported values divided by raw native ft²/ft values are approximately 0.160514/0.4008 rather than the expected 0.0929034/0.3048006. This repeated factor indicates an apparent source-field unit conversion inconsistency; the precise cause is undocumented. Geometry was computed from rings in the declared native CRS, not from those attribute values.

Added photo-backed, approximate gabled roof masses, chimney, brick-colored walls, light window trim, rectangular window rhythm and a shallow entrance canopy. Their dimensions and exact placement are not surveyed.
uncertainties: Height: not measured. Eaves and ridges are illustrative estimates; the photo establishes multi-level appearance but offers no scale. Purdue Extrution=12 has undocumented units and is not used as a verified height.
Roof: 2022 captioned chapter-house photo supports several pitched gables and a tall brick chimney. Exact ridge positions and elevations are estimated; orthophoto helps only with plan roof envelope.

Facade/entrance: 2022 source supports brick/masonry appearance, white trim, windows and a modest covered entrance. Exact opening dimensions, locations and entrance orientation are approximate from an unscaled oblique image.
Footprint: independent 2018 LiDAR outline overlaps Purdue FID 784 at IoU 0.7573 and fits the visible roof outline better. It is a roof-derived outline, not a surveyed foundation perimeter.

Published Shape__Area/Shape__Length attributes in both GIS layers exhibit a nearly matching nonstandard conversion factor relative to native ft²/ft geometry. This is documented as a source attribute inconsistency; the responsible processing step is unknown.
